signal.description: An observable box containing a mutable value. Reading its value registers a dependency implicitly.

Async Signal.description: An async Signal Object mapping loading, data success, and error failure states cleanly.

Computed.description: Combine multiple signals into a derived, lazily-cached, read-only signal.

AsyncComputed.description: Asynchronous Computed is syntax sugar around FutureSignal for async dependent tasks.

linkedSignal.description: A writable derived signal that allows manual updates and resets to a source computation on mutation.

ChangeStackSignal.description: Track signal values over time, exposing simple, robust undo/redo capabilities.
body: final ${1:name} = changeStack(${2:value}, limit: ${3:null}, options: SignalOptions(name: '${1:name}', autoDispose: ${4:false}));

IterableSignal.description: Iterable signals wrap collection items lazy-traversals mapped to custom reactivity layer.

ListSignal.description: Optimized list wrapper proxying standard operations to support element-level reactivity.

MapSignal.description: Granular map wrapper supporting isolated dictionary element lookup triggers.

SetSignal.description: Custom set wrapper ignoring duplicate entries and triggering mutations on unique inserts.

FutureSignal.description: Bypasses stream subscription overhead and resolves the future-evaluation loop elegantly.

StreamSignal.description: Dynamic, lifecycle-safe, self-disposing stream listener mapping to async loading/data/error states.

Signal Container (Read-only).description: Returns a read-only parameterized caching Signal Container.

Signal Container.description: Returns a mutable parameterized caching Signal Container.

Watch builder.description: Explicit in-place Flutter Watch widget rebuilding only the returned closure closure.

Watch.description: Rebuilds only the wrapped closure when tracked signals change, avoiding full-widget GPU paints.

SignalBuilder.description: Subscribes to a single signal, rebuilding only this local builder block when it changes.

SignalEffect.description: Executes standard Flutter side effects (Snackbars, dialogs) inside widget lifecycles safely.

Value Signal.description: Custom Value Signal class definition template.
